editorial:
If you love loud engines, brutal crashes, and over-the-top prison action, this one is right up your alley. The story follows Connor Gibson, a Black Ops specialist who sneaks into a maximum security prison to take down the legendary driver known as Frankenstein in a deadly car race. The whole thing feels like a wild mix of Mad Max and a prison break movie, with plenty of explosions, fistfights, and crazy stunts to keep you entertained from start to finish. The vibe is unapologetically gritty and violent, so you know exactly what you are getting into before you even press play.

The action scenes are the real star here, with well-shot races and brutal hand-to-hand fights that keep the energy high. The acting is solid enough for this kind of movie, and the pacing rarely slows down long enough for you to get bored. On the downside, the plot is pretty thin and some of the dialogue feels cheesy, but that is part of the charm. If you are in the mood for pure, brain-off entertainment, this delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final race, Connor Gibson finally faces Frankenstein head-on in a brutal showdown. After a series of crashes and close calls, Connor manages to defeat Frankenstein and take control of the race. The twist comes when it is revealed that Connor was not just there to win, but to expose the corrupt prison system running the deadly event. With Frankenstein out of the picture, Connor escapes the prison and the race is shut down, leaving the corrupt wardens exposed and the prisoners finally free from the deadly spectacle.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-octane action movies and prison thrillers.
